## Description

Uses attention, gating and multi-horizon temporal components to forecast returns, volatility or other trading features from static and time-varying covariates.

## Where it may fit

Multi-horizon forecasting tasks where nonlinear covariates and changing temporal relationships matter.

## Vehicles

Quant equity, systematic macro, futures and crypto; forecasts must feed a separate portfolio/risk layer.

## Required data

Chronological price/return history, engineered covariates, point-in-time fundamentals/macro, labels and train/validation splits.

## Caveats

Forecast accuracy is not trading profitability; guard against leakage, retraining instability, multiple testing and costs.
